environment: Node 22.23.3; local macOS Chrome; reduced-motion browser tests
interaction_checks: Collection preserves search and selected identity across presentations
No-results recovery restores all collection items
Create validates, focuses invalid field, and commits fixture data
Dirty Escape keeps draft, offers discard and restores trigger focus
Save failure retains draft and stays in dialog
Destructive confirmation focuses Cancel and contains keyboard focus
Permission resolves once and removes obsolete decisions
Email rule requires a preview before activation
Workspace navigation resets domain records and opens long-form editors
Long editor guards navigation and keeps its unsaved values
Source categories expose distinct cached conversations and empty results
Action popover closes on Escape and restores its trigger
Read-only records do not offer editing controls
limitations: Fixture verification, not full accessibility certification or native/backend integration validation.
